affected_system: municipal capital planning, debt, grants, reserves, procurement, and asset delivery
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook
pair scenario-based revenue, cost, cash-flow, and project-stage forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Budgets, obligations, appropriations, encumbrances, expenditures, schedules, and assets are reconciled.
All fiscal scenarios separate nominal, real, committed, contingent, and modeled amounts.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook.

constraints.description: The capital portfolio and municipal finance forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief financial officer and capital planning director
decision_question: What range of costs, revenues, grants, debt service, cash flow, and completion should planning use?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The capital portfolio and municipal finance forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: scenario-based revenue, cost, cash-flow, and project-stage forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: capital obligation above affordable deliverable capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: capital obligation above affordable deliverable capacity
distributional gap in capital obligation above affordable deliverable capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present a fiscal scenario as an audited forecast, rating opinion, or promised project completion.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for multi-year municipal capital and fiscal outlook passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast capital cost, revenue, debt, and delivery capacity
transportability_risks: Accounting, tax authority, debt limits, grants, procurement, labor, and markets differ.
Historical delivery and cost relationships may shift under inflation or policy change.
